**Creator-reported model · Source-only; not independently reproduced**

One ten-ad satirical series, not ten separate cases. Nine original eight-frame GIFs are archived; the supplement sample with a fabricated named-person endorsement stays source-link only. The article supplies short scenarios but does not establish that these are verbatim original prompts, so prompt availability is unverified. These are non-interactive visual parodies, not genuine endorsements, investment/health/security advice or deployed ads. Fake threat counts and commercial claims are fictional visual content. Header and introductory artwork are excluded because their model attribution is not established.
